description: Discharge Cases (Spills) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Saskatchewan | Gouvernement de la Saskatchewan. This map data displays environmental discharges (spills) in Saskatchewan with location, confirmed substance and quantity. This data is limited to events that occurred between January 1, 2015 to present. The Ministry of Environment is responsible for responding to incidents where a substance of potential concern has been discharged into the environment. Coverage: Government of Saskatchewan. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Saskatchewan | Gouvernement de la Saskatchewan. Its tags are Public, Discharge, Cases, Spill, Hazardous. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-04-16 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Saskatchewan Standard Unrestricted Use Data License (Version 2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
